money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 30 Apr 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 30 Apr 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted nearest-start, shortest special repo (start T+0, 4 days; no trade of <= 3 days) (3.65%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 30 Apr 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 4 May 2026 (tables headed 01.05.2026, Labour Day: the PL IRS, FRA and spread levels are the 30 Apr closes - their change columns are measured against 30 Apr and are zero) (table headed 30.04.2026; only the 30 Apr 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 30 Apr 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 30 Apr 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 30 Apr 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.67% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (PS1026 3.68%, OK0127 3.66%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 30 Apr 2026 (holdings and statistics as of 27 Apr 2026; published 28 Apr 2026, PDF CreationDate 28 Apr 15:38 CEST, HTTP Last-Modified 28 Apr 17:47 CEST). Changes: PS0731 enters TBSP and B5Y; WS0429 enters B1Y3Y (leaves B3Y5Y); WZ1126 leaves BWZ. Units match MoF settlements to 27 Apr (sales of 15 and 23 Apr).
